title: Specified-compactification normalized exceptional Hom chain
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring in the coefficient universe, let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes with $Y$ quasi-compact, and fix a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Suppose the ordinary etale compact-support functor at $c$ is equipped with its IsLeftAdjoint instance. For $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ equipped with a retained etale origin $W=(M_e,\alpha)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, define the canonical equivalence $\operatorname{Hom}(Rp_{c,*}j_!M,L)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,\nu_X^*f^\times_{c,\Lambda}R\nu_{Y,*}L)$ [def-sfb-finite-derived-lower-shriek-compactification] [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] by composing, in order: the inverse of the isomorphism induced by $Rp_{c,*}j_!\alpha$; the normalized proper/open compact-support comparison at $M_e$; the derived comparison adjunction at $Y$; the specified ordinary etale adjunction at $c$; the fully faithful comparison Hom map at $X$ on the bounded-below target; and the isomorphism induced by $\alpha$. This defines a particular chain of canonical maps and makes no arbitrary choice of a Hom equivalence.
